alerts.name: Cookie Slack Detector
alerts.desc: Repeated GET requests: drop a different cookie each time, followed by normal request with all cookies to stabilize session, compare responses against original baseline GET. This can reveal areas where cookie based authentication/attributes are not actually enforced.
alerts.otherinfo: Dropping this cookie appears to have invalidated the session: [_hjSessionUser_2738795] A follow-on request with all original cookies still had a different response than the original request.
